text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш prevails over her senior-year

competitors. It was a heated battle, but
there's no
denying she has taken a big
step forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She will likely face the two experienced
racers
again at the Arima Kinen, but
Eishin Flash is
confident all she has to do
is win again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
